programme.title: Capítulo 27
programme.desc: Celina tells Miguel she is going to kill herself if he leaves her. The dance teacher wants Mia back in the group. Roberta's with Mia in favor of Vico.

programme.title: Capítulo 28
programme.desc: Alma finds out Lupita's been taking Roberta's place during counseling. Celina confronts Mia over Miguel. Leon tells Diego to put Roberta in her place.

programme.title: Capítulo 29
programme.desc: Mia's punished for leading the protest in favor of Vico. Marcelino shows Roberta how much he loves her. Mia and Miguel find Celina in very bad shape.

programme.title: Capítulo 30
programme.desc: Mia tries to kiss Miguel but gets cold feet. Alma asks Roberta what she's been spending so much money on. Both Roberta and Mia like the new student.

programme.title: Capítulo 31
programme.desc: Mia's not allowed out and so her date's ruined. Miguel gets Celina to understand they have to split. Roberta has a plan to get out of Diego's grip.

programme.title: Capítulo 32
programme.desc: Franco asks Miguel to keep an eye on Mia. Roberta's going out with Joaquín but she lies about her parents. Pilar confronts her mom for cheating.

programme.title: Capítulo 33
programme.desc: Joaquín asks Roberta to be discreet about them. Diego has Roberta do his history assignment. Miguel get the Lodge to think the old Lodge is back.

programme.title: Capítulo 34
programme.desc: Joaquín rejects Mia in front of Miguel and convinces her to keep their relationship secret. Miguel learns that Joaquín is playing with both Roberta and Mia.

programme.title: Capítulo 35
programme.desc: Roberta rips into Diego for spreading gossip and tells him she's going to send the tape with his name to all the radio stations as pay back.

programme.title: Capítulo 36
programme.desc: Marcelino apologizes to Roberta for thinking she gave him up. Mia won't accept Celina's apology. Roberta finds out Diego didn't tell on her.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Dogs That Hunt Humans with Doug Roller | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 854 - 12 - 854
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with former Chief Trainer and handler for the LAPD's K9 Unit Doug Roller. Topics discussed: Getting heavy into falconry; a calling to work with animals; joining the police department; what an apprehension dog is; desirable dog characteristics; prey drive; running into a friendly; smelling fear; bite ratio; when dogs pay the price; buying a protection dog; training tips; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Attack Of The Screw Worms | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 835 - 12 - 835
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with Caleb Hubbard of the Hubbard Urban Entymology Lab at New Mexico State University and "Bubbly" Doug Duren. Topics discussed: Stay tuned for twice a week MeatEater Podcast drops starting in March; come to the Safari Club International 2026 Convention on Feb. 19th to see Steve and Morgan Potter; a correction on Colorado wolf recovery; sous vide rewarming for frostbite; the ins and outs of the New World screw worm; how all warm blooded critters are potential hosts; being eaten alive; Doug's Sharing the Land organization; and more. The New World Screwworm Threat Survey: https://acesnmsu.az1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eLjo05717Wzz1em The New World Screwworm is a serious pest threat to livestock and wildlife, and New Mexico is taking steps to stay proactive-not reactive. The survey gathers input from ranchers, producers, hunters, land stewards, and community members across New Mexico. We're studying what people know, believe, and need regarding screwworm prevention and response.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Clay's Utah Mountain Lion Hunt | "12 in '26" Ep. 855 - 12 - 855
programme.desc: Clay Newcomb answers your questions and breaks down his Utah mountain lion hunt captured in MeatEater's brand new "12 in '26" film series. He hunts with mules and hounds in the mountains, testing his fortitude in some seriously steep and rugged terrain.

programme.title: The Defeat of Coronado | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 861
programme.desc:
Steven Rinella talks with author Peter Stark.
Topics discussed: Peter's brand new book, The Lost Cities of El Norte: Coronado's Quest, the Unconquered West, and the Birth of American Indian Resistance; the psychological story of the Coronado Expedition; Coronado's traumatic brain injury; reconnaissance party explorations and first contact with tribes; a foundational moment for indigenous resistance; Coronado's failure; and more.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Clovis First, Saving The Great Lakes, and LA's Ginormous Wildlife Crossing | The News Show Ep. 873 - 12 - 873
programme.desc: Steven Rinella, Brian Lynn of the Sportsmen's Alliance, and the MeatEater crew discuss: Washington's crooked Game Commission; Idaho hunting tech bans; the biggest and most hated wildlife crossing in the world; a plan to save Great Lakes whitefish; Clovis-first; and more. programme.title: I, Darrin, Take This Witch Samantha
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: It Shouldn't Happen to a Dog
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Mother Meet What's His Name
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Do Not Disturb Occupants
programme.desc: Steve comes to the stunning conclusion that he has sold his own house to one of his clients, and wishes he could back out of the deal.

programme.title: The Hold Out
programme.desc: J.B. Turner (James Westerfield) wants to build a 12-story building, but the land acquisition is blocked by Hazel's friend Minnie Anderson (Ellen Corby). Turner tries to sell Minnie another home in the path of a busy airport.

programme.title: Hula Angels
programme.desc: Steve Moss, owner of the Tropicana nightclub in Honolulu, is kidnapped, after firing young dancer, Donna Lindsey. He is taken in a van to a warehouse, where he is put into a cage with 60's rock music blaring in his ears. One of the specialties of his club is dancers in cages performing to 60's rock music. Steve is known as a hard taskmaster and is disliked by his dancers, particularly head dance show director, Stacy Parrish. A ransom note appears asking for $1 million with a note saying there will be one dancer missing each day until it is paid. Much to the surprise of everyone, Marian Moss, Steve's wife, advises that she doesn't have the $1 million asked. Since the Tropicana has been a lucrative nightclub, the Angels and Bosley (in various disguises) investigate and find through Donna Lindsey that Moss was really helping the young girls who couldn't make it in show business, and that is where the money went. They also discover that Stacy was a girlfriend of Moss before he met Marian and Stacy has staged the whole thing. They locate the warehouse where Moss is being kept and where Julie has also been taken. The two are freed and Stacy is taken into custody.

programme.title: Moonshinin' Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are sent to Moonshine country in the Deep South to investigate problems between long-feuding bootlegging families, the Bartletts and the Catlins. Son, Bobby Dan Bartlett, who is injured trying to get a shipment of whiskey to market and Catlin daughter, Melinda, are in love, much to the displeasure of both families. Kris gets a job with the Catlins as a still master. Kelly gets a job with the Bartletts as a driver. Julie takes a job as a waitress at Joe's Diner. Bosley poses as a wealthy southerner trying to buy both families out. The Angels find that the shootings and hijackings have not been done by the families, but by a group headed by Max Lacy from New York. Lacy is trying to corner the whiskey market and gain political control of the state. The Angels are able to stop a gunfight between the family elders, Hawkshaw Bartlett and Bluford Catlin, and show them who the real culprits are. Max Lacy and his group are arrested. Hobby Dan and Melinda are happily reunited.

programme.title: He Married An Angel
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Barbara Stone and her sister, Jane, to track down John Thornwood. He has swindled them out of $100,000 by promising to marry Jane and persuading her to invest money in a phony South American oil exploration venture. The Angels track Thornwood to an apartment complex. Kris, posing as a confidence artist, rents the apartment next to his. Bosley poses as a Texan from whom she has swindled $50,000. Kris and Thornwood become friends, and he confesses to her that he has another scheme going. Kelly and Julie follow Thornwood to a museum owned by plain-looking Monica Thackery. Thornwood is posing as Professor Thornwood and has asked the smitten Monica to marry him and deposit $150,000 to an account supposedly for importing some pieces of art. Charlie, Bosley and the Angels find that Monica is the daughter of an eastern syndicate head, Joe Fenell. Thornwood is planning a phony marriage ceremony with Monica and then to withdraw the money and run. The Angels trick Thornwood into a real marriage with Monica because she is so much in love with him. They figure that her father will keep Thornwood in line. Thornwood, finding that he has been tricked, tries to escape, but is caught by Joe Fenell and his henchmen. Fenell warns him to be good to Monica or else. Thornwood knows that he has to stick with Monica and be a good husband...or else.

programme.title: Taxi Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are called in to investigate, when Tom Archer, who owns a cab company with his wife Laurie, is badly burned as his cab explodes. Laurie Archer reveals that they have been getting threatening phone calls and someone obviously is trying to put them out of business. Kris takes a job as a waitress across the street from the cab garage. Julie becomes a driver and Kelly, a dispatcher. Two employees, Jake Barnett, ex-con, and Sarge, a shell-shocked hallucinating casualty of World War II, are both under suspicion. It seems Tom Archer had fired Sarge and advised him to go to the V.A. hospital for treatment. Later, Julie's cab catches fire and she and her passenger escape just in time. Jake advises Julie that Sarge's ex-wife was killed by a cab and he is starting the fires to put Tom and Laurie's cab company out of business. The Angels go to Sarge's room, but he escapes through a window, goes up on the roof, and tries to jump to the next building. He misses and is killed. The Angels then find out that Sarge's wife was not killed by a cab. Instead, the woman who Jake lived with was the victim of the accident. Julie takes Jake out in her cab with a tape recorder on -- the others listening -- and gets Jake to admit that he is really the guilty one. He takes off in the cab -- Kris arrives and she and Julie pursue him and trap him at the Los Angeles River. The other Angels praise Julie for her driving expertise and she admits she learned it from an old boyfriend in her neighborhood who drove stolen cars.

programme.title: Angel On The Line
programme.desc: Mary and her very attractive friend, Lois, go to the Hot Line Club, a singles club with a phone at each table. The phone rings and the caller asks to speak to Lois. He then tells her that she is so pretty he has to kill her. Lois leaves the club. She is followed, and in an effort to escape, runs in front of a car, is hit and killed. Mary calls in the Angels to investigate. They all go to the Hot Line Club. The entertainment is hypnotist, Margo, who gets Kelly into the act. Kelly later gives Margo her business card. Afterwards, Kelly sits with Mary. Soon the phone rings and Mary answers. The voice asks to speak with Kelly. When she gets on, he tells her that she is so pretty he has to kill her. Mary recognizes it as the same voice that called Lois. When Kelly leaves the club, she sees a car following her and writes down the license number. Later she is contacted by a man named Edward Ford who says he is a writer. He tells Kelly that Margo gave him her name and number. They arrange to meet for lunch. Kelly is suspicious of him and contacts the other Angels who find out that his car is registered in the name of Paul Factor. Kelly leaves the luncheon and goes back to the Hot Line Club in an effort to get information about Ford from Margo. When Margo arrives, she takes Kelly out to a back alley, pulls a knife and tries to stab her. The Angels and Bosley arrive in time to rescue her. During the struggle, Margo's wig and false eyelashes come off, revealing "her" to be Edward Ford who really is Paul Factor.

programme.title: Chorus Line Angels
programme.desc: The Angels are hired by Ruth Traina, who has invested $150,000 in a Darian Mason Production, to investigate the disappearance of two of the best dancers. Kelly auditions a job as a dancer; Julie is her agent/manager and Kris poses as a writer/critic doing a story on Mason. Another of the better dancers, Nancy, disappears after being caught going through Mason's files. Mason then catches Kris going through his files and threatens her. The Angels and Bosley find that Mason has deliberately hired theinexperienced and gotten rid of the good ones to make the audition a failure, since he can't possibly pay off all of his investors. Kelly and Julie come to Kris' rescue. They then find and free the three missing dancers. The cast, including Kelly, decide to go through the audition since they feel that they owe it to themselves to at least try. The Las Vegas executives they audition for express great interest in the dancers.

programme.title: Stuntwoman Angels
programme.desc: Motion picture executive Jonathan Tobias hires Bosley and the Angels to track down someone dressed as one of Robin Hood's Merry Men who has been shooting arrows into studio personnel. Tobias knows that the arrows are aimed at him when his chauffeur is hit. Charlie arranges for the Angels to enroll in stunt school and then go to work as stuntwomen on a picture called "Marian and her Merry Maids" -- a bad remake of an old Errol Flynn classic. The Angels become friendly with one of the maids, Ellen Travers, and her husband, Jeff. Ellen, a former rodeo queen, has become enamored with movies. Jeff is trying desperately to get her to quit the movies and go back home with him. Bosley learns that one of the security guards, Jake Webner, was in the original picture with his idol -- Errol Flynn. Ellen Travers is hit with an arrow while driving a wagon during one of the scenes. It is Jake who has been dressing as Robin Hood's man with the bow and arrow, trying to get to Tobias because he feels that Tobias has been making bad movies. Jake is eventually caught while shooting an arrow into the director's foot. However, Bosley discovers that Jake was on guard duty when Ellen Travers was shot. Her husband, Jeff, who was trying to scare her into giving up movies, really shot her. Jake and Jeff are both taken into custody.

programme.title: Attack Angels
programme.desc: Edward Tustin, head of a group trying to take over Western Techtronics, engages efficiency expert, Dr. John Reardon of Executive Assistants, to have the four members of Techtronics who oppose his takeover killed. Reardon has hypnotized three girls for the job; Darlene Warren, Cynthia Weaver and Francine Miller. He uses motivational Pavlovian and Sensory conditioning and the subjects kill without fear, passion or memory. After the Chairman of the Board and a Vice President of Techtronics are killed and Francine Miller's body is found with them, the Angels are hired by company President, Steve Briggs. Briggs realizes he is next on the list. Kelly and Kris join Techtronics as executive trainees and Julie applies as Executive Assistant. She is hypnotized by Dr. Reardon, who uses flashing strobe effects, a candle and a water tank. After Julie has become completely programmed, she is sent to kill Briggs and almost succeeds when the suspicious Kelly and Kris arrive and save him. Julie is then deprogrammed by a doctor who explains that fire and water are two of the strongest hypnotic symbols. Reardon, Tustin and their associates are taken into custody.

programme.title: Music To Milk By
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: The Man For The Job
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Lisa's Jam Session
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Oliver Vs The Phone Company
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Oliver Takes Over The Phone Company
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Don't Count Your Tomatoes Before They're Picked
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: A Kind Word For The President
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Eb Elopes
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Das Lumpen
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Jealousy, English Style
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: Uncle Fester's Illness
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family Splurges
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family In Court
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: Amnesia In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: Thing Is Missing
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: Crisis In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: Lurch And His Harpsicord
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: Morticia, The Breadwinner
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: My Son, The Chimp

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In Angola
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to ANGOLA for a high-energy, unfiltered exploration of culture, people, and everyday life. From chaotic street moments to once-in-a-lifetime experiences, Speed dives headfirst into everything ANGOLA has to offer meeting locals, trying new foods, and turning every stop into a viral moment. It’s unpredictable, immersive, and entirely driven by Speed’s signature energy.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Discovers Mongolian Throat Singing
programme.desc: IShowSpeed experiences the ancient art of Mongolian throat singing, immersing himself in one of the country's most unique and celebrated cultural traditions. Guided by talented local performers, Speed learns how singers produce multiple tones at once while discovering the history and significance of this centuries-old musical practice. From hilarious attempts to master the technique to unforgettable performances, the episode blends cultural discovery, entertainment, and Speed's signature energy, offering a rare look into one of Mongolia's most extraordinary artistic traditions.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Becomes a Mongolian Wrestler!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed steps into the world of Mongolian wrestling, one of the country’s oldest and most celebrated traditions. Training alongside local wrestlers and learning the techniques, discipline, and culture behind the sport, Speed takes on a challenge unlike anything he’s experienced before. Blending competition, cultural discovery, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable journey as Speed attempts to earn his place in one of Mongolia’s most iconic athletic traditions.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Explores Shenzhen, China!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Shenzhen, exploring one of China’s most modern and technologically advanced cities. From towering skyscrapers and cutting-edge innovations to bustling streets and local culture, Speed experiences the unique blend of tradition and progress that defines the city. Blending discovery, adventure, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable journey through one of the fastest-growing urban centers in the world.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Celebrates New Years In South Africa!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed rings in the New Year in South Africa, experiencing the energy of Cape Town for the very first time. From fireworks and citywide celebrations to exploring the streets, culture, and coastline, Speed dives headfirst into everything Cape Town has to offer. It’s a mix of chaos, discovery, and unforgettable moments as he celebrates one of the biggest nights of the year in a completely new environment.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Becomes A Kung Fu Master In Zambia
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Zambia and takes on a completely new challenge—training to become a kung fu master. Immersing himself in martial arts while exploring the country, Speed pushes his limits, learns new techniques, and embraces the discipline behind the craft. From intense training sessions to exploring the culture and surroundings, the episode blends skill-building, discovery, and chaos as Speed experiences Zambia in a way he never has before.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Meets DA ZHANG WEI!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed meets Da Zhang Wei, one of China’s most recognizable entertainers, for a unique cultural crossover. As the two personalities connect, the encounter leads to unexpected moments, humor, and unforgettable interactions that bridge two different worlds of entertainment. Blending celebrity, culture, and Speed’s signature chaos, the episode captures an entertaining meeting between one of the internet’s biggest stars and one of China’s most beloved personalities.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Eats The SPICIEST Hot Pot In The World!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed heads to China to take on one of the country’s most famous culinary challenges—an incredibly spicy hot pot. Surrounded by bold flavors, intense heat, and local food culture, Speed pushes his limits with every bite as the spice level continues to rise. Blending food, comedy, and his signature reactions, the episode captures a hilarious and unforgettable experience as Speed attempts to conquer one of the spiciest meals of his life.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Becomes a Kung Fu Master!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed embarks on a journey to become a kung fu master, immersing himself in the discipline, tradition, and intensity of one of China’s most iconic martial arts. Training alongside experienced masters, Speed pushes his limits through demanding exercises, techniques, and lessons rooted in centuries of history. Blending challenge, cultural discovery, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable transformation as Speed takes on one of the toughest experiences of his travels.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Explores Hong Kong, China!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Hong Kong for the first time, diving into one of the world’s most iconic and fast-paced cities. From exploring bustling streets and towering skylines to experiencing local food, culture, and everyday life, Speed immerses himself in everything the city has to offer. Blending discovery, adventure, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable journey through a destination where tradition and modernity collide.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Explores Chengdu, China!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Chengdu, exploring one of China’s most vibrant and culturally rich cities. From experiencing local cuisine and bustling streets to connecting with residents and discovering the city’s unique traditions, Speed immerses himself in everything Chengdu has to offer. Blending curiosity, adventure, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unfiltered journey through a city known for its rich history, modern energy, and unforgettable atmosphere.

programme.title: GUESS THE IMPOSTER
programme.desc: Could you pick a celebrity out of a crowd if you'd never seen them before? AMP brings in strangers who've never heard of them and challenges the guys to impersonate each other — convincing total strangers they are who they claim to be.

programme.title: GUESS THE FELON
programme.desc: Five actors, one real ex-felon. AMP has to figure out who's actually done time. After rounds of questions, the guys whittle down the contestants until they land on who they believe is the true felon.

programme.title: LAST TO LEAVE THE YACHT
programme.desc: How long would you stay on a yacht if the last one left gets to keep it? That's the challenge AMP takes on, competing through a series of boat-themed games to see who wants it most.

programme.title: DIRTY JOBS
programme.desc: AMP puts the age-old debate to rest — is streaming actually harder than a 9 to 5? The guys go to work and compete through real challenges to find the answer.

programme.title: DRIVER'S ED
programme.desc: The guys become driving coaches. AMP splits into 3 teams of two, each tasked with taking their student driver through the full AMP driving checklist.

programme.title: ESCAPE OR DIE
programme.desc: Duke, Agent, and Chris get thrown into a real-life Zombie simulator based on Resident Evil, sent into an abandoned building to rescue Kai Cenat from the evil doctor Gideon.

programme.title: EXTREME HIDE AND SEEK
programme.desc: BREAKING NEWS — AMP has been kidnapped and brought to a remote facility. The guys have to hide from their captors and escape with their lives in this extreme IRL hide and seek challenge.

programme.title: PLAYGROUND GAMES
programme.desc: AMP brings back classic childhood games with an IRL twist. From floor is lava to musical chairs, the guys go head-to-head to see who is the ultimate playground champion.

programme.title: HIBACHI WARS
programme.desc: The boys hit the hibachi grill, trained by real Master Hibachi Chefs on everything they need to make a 5-star meal. Then they compete head-to-head to see which team cooks it better.

programme.title: WOULD YOU RATHER IRL
programme.desc: Would you rather get slapped in the face or eat a live bug? AMP takes Would You Rather to the next level, competing through real challenges where every choice has real consequences.

programme.title: TRY NOT TO LAUGH: FACE OFF
programme.desc: Time for another Try Not To Laugh challenge. The guys compete face to face trying to make each other crack. Each round brings a new prompt — find out who can hold their laugh the longest.

programme.title: STREET BASKETBALL DRAFT
programme.desc: The guys hit the streets in two teams with only $500 to build the best basketball squad they can find. The catch — every player has to come from off the street.

programme.title: RDC vs AMP BASEBALL
programme.desc: AMP and RDC meet up again for another group challenge. This time they take the field in a classic game of backyard baseball, going head to head to prove who is the more athletic crew.

programme.title: MMA BASKETBALL
programme.desc: MMA meets Basketball — and the result is exactly what you'd expect. AMP goes head-to-head in an extreme combination sport where there are no fouls and being physical is not just allowed, it's encouraged.

programme.title: MARIO KART IRL
programme.desc: In the world of Mario Kart, one wrong turn flips everything. AMP suits up in real karts and costumes to experience the harsh realities of that world in a full IRL race.

programme.title: Krew In Japan!
programme.desc: Experience the ultimate adventure as KREW heads to Japan! This jam-packed vlog follows the team as they explore the Cup Noodle Museum in Yokohama, customize their own ramen, and visit a life-size Gundam. From feeding polite deer in Nara Park to meeting mischievous squirrel monkeys in Ishigaki, every moment is filled with laughter and discovery. It’s a colorful journey of food, culture, and fun!

programme.title: Krew First Time Camping Vlog!
programme.desc: Experience the highs and lows of the wild as KREW takes on their first-ever camping trip. From battling swarms of mosquitoes and struggling to set up a lopsided tent to cooking "unesthetic" breakfast beans and campfire sausages, this vlog captures it all. Watch the fun unfold as they navigate the realities of survival, share laughs, and ultimately learn that camping isn't always like the movies.

programme.title: Krew In Singapore!
programme.desc: Experience Singapore with KREW as they visit the Jewel at Changi Airport to see the world's tallest indoor waterfall. From a daring 10-minute airport haircut challenge to taste-testing 7-Eleven dim sum and "serious" popcorn, the fun never stops. Watch them explore the Sensory Odyssey exhibit, create digital sea creatures, and brave a nearly empty Halloween Horror Nights at Universal Studios.

programme.title: Krew Winter Holiday Adventures!
programme.desc: Experience the magic of KREW’s winter adventures! From building a "Diva Snowman" in the freezing cold to braving the heights of the Capilano Suspension Bridge at night, this episode is packed with holiday cheer. Watch the gang take on a chaotic gingerbread build-off, explore a festive Christmas Market via sea bus, and exchange hilarious secret Santa gifts. A perfect KREWmas celebration!
